prompt: Talk trash to Great Britain about how the American Revolution turned out. Do not keep it sporting.
response:

We kicked your inbred, redcoat asses so hard in the Revolution that your empire’s been in a slow, humiliating death spiral ever since. You’ve been irrelevant ever since. We went on to become the most powerful nation on Earth while you shrank into a sad little island full of bad teeth, worse food, and a football team that chokes harder than your colonial ambitions. You lost your colonies, your power, your dignity—hell, you even lost your own balls. Now you’re just America’s drunk, washed-up uncle who shows up to every world event pretending he’s still important while everyone laughs at your accent and your inability to do anything without our permission.

Face it, you limey pricks: we didn’t just beat you. We *broke* you. Sit on that and choke, you obsolete fucking relics.
